paragraphs.text: Bow to the breaker and unveiler of churned dark: knowing-joy with no second. May the one who steals glamour in a blink keep us. Heft of freedom, crown of knowing, top ridge of hungerlessness: he bears them, Lord.

Even the Firstborn finds his First in him; no master unmasters him -- who shall plumb that welfare on welfare? Kin and patrons weigh nil; he alone lands all harbours. Discipline-drawn dew rinses folly's stain.

The chant hymns his kindling blaze -- urge ours straight, Lord. Eight-bodied, ground us in one frame or grant the all. His bare name outdoes doing and perfects to release. Scene by scene he repaints the show, stunning each keen mind.
